en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a market square and adjoining street in a European town. The scene shows historic multi‑story buildings with gabled roofs and decorative facades. In the center-right stands a building labeled "Hôtel Goldener Löwe," with horse‑drawn carriages and people in early 20th‑century clothing in front. On the left side is a row of shops, one with an awning and a bicycle leaning against the curb. The caption at the top reads "Wurzen. Am Markt." indicating that this is the market area of Wurzen.
